summary: Tested Progression Hub (Phase 2) end-to-end. Backend GET /api/atlas/progression/hub returns 200 with all required fields (level, level_name_*, total_xp, xp_for_next_level, xp_progress, streak, 5 skills, 32 badges across 7 categories, modules counts, daily_goals with 3 goals, priority, quiz stats). Frontend ProgressView renders the full hub correctly: hero (Level 1 Curious, 80 XP, animated XP bar to 20 XP -> Explorer), quick stats (Streak 0, Badges 3/32, Modules 0/3), priority RESUME card with correct module title, 3 daily goals (0/1 +20, 0/5 +15, 0/1 +25), 5 skills at 0/10, all 7 badge categories with earned/locked visual states, modules overview (3/3/0/0) with recent list showing progress %, and quiz stats (1 quiz, 100% avg, 1 perfect, 3 days active). Priority-card click navigates to Chat tab and pre-fills the correct message ('I want to continue the module "...". Pick up where we left off.'). 12/12 backend tests pass, all critical frontend flows verified.

ui_bugs.issue: data-testid="priority-card" prop on TouchableOpacity is not emitted to DOM by React Native Web. Use testID="priority-card" instead so it gets translated to data-testid. Functionality works when clicking the visible RESUME text.

action_items: (Optional/low) Change data-testid="priority-card" to testID="priority-card" on the TouchableOpacity at learn.tsx:1155 for reliable e2e selection. Other tabs already use testID which flows to data-testid correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: learn.tsx is very large (1695+ lines). Consider extracting ProgressView and its ph StyleSheet into a dedicated module to improve maintainability.

TouchableOpacity uses raw data-testid attr which is not standard for RN Web; testID is the RN Web convention and is what other buttons in the app use (atlas-tab-progress etc.). Inconsistency reduces test-ability.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Progression Hub API schema is flat (not nested under 'xp'/'level' objects): fields include level (int), level_name_fr/en/es, total_xp, xp_for_next_level, xp_progress, streak, skills (list of 5), badges (list of 32), badges_earned/total, modules_total/in_progress/completed/mastered, recent_modules, daily_goals={goals:[], all_completed, bonus_xp, date}, priority={type,title,...}, stats. Frontend Progress tab is [data-testid='atlas-tab-progress']. Priority card lacks a working testid.
